I am an old woman with only this small plot of land that my family has tended for generations. At my age, I cannot do the heavy work anymore, so I rely on my children and grandchildren to help. We do not have money to buy chemical fertilizers or pesticides from the shop, but we have a few goats and chickens, so we spread their manure on the field to help the crops grow. We plant the seeds we saved from last season and wait for the rains, as we have no way to water the land ourselves.
